title: Clinical Agents Don’t Care

live_model.evidence: Results: "GPT-4.1-nano detected 4.4% of header swaps and <1% of MRN or age changes"; "22/500 (4.4%) UNKNOWN on header swap".

prompt.note: Agents received a fixed prompt with the patient's name/MRN, instructed to extract ten VisitIDs and copy the ICD-10-CM code or respond UNKNOWN; paraphrased only in the paper, exact wording promised on GitHub post-publication.

claim.location: Results ("GPT-4.1-nano produced 22/500 (4.4%) UNKNOWN on header swap")

data.source: MIMIC-IV (credentialed PhysioNet access) plus a synthetic tamper/header-swap layer; code, prompts and synthetic headers promised on GitHub "upon publication", not yet in the text reviewed

notes: Agentic tool-calling task (Extract/Store APIs) run over 500 ten-record batches per arm, 4 arms, 6 models = 12,000 runs / ~1.2M tool calls total; per-model per-arm n=500. Prompt is paraphrased rather than quoted verbatim.
